description: Get the latest US dollar price of crypto COINS (not stocks: BTC here is Bitcoin, not a stock ticker), up to 25 a call: last trade price and its UTC time, the 24-hour change, and the 24-hour volume, high and low. Prices and volume are one exchange's, not the whole market's; there is no market cap. A quiet coin shows an old last-trade time; that is its real last trade. Pro reads real time, Plus 15 minutes delayed, Free gets an upgrade note (daily candles are in GetCryptoPrices). ListCryptoAssets lists the symbols.

symbols.description: Coin symbols (max 25), e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL; BTC/USD and BTC-USD also work
